documentQualityDecisions.rationale: Affected-resource ID accurately describes the refined armResourceIdentifier type.
Created role-assignment resource ID remains accurate after the identifier refinement; the null wording already existed on the nonnullable optional string and is not newly introduced.
The workspace identity description matches the new ARM resource identifier.
Permission error describes the resource, missing permissions and required roles model; the ID refinement does not change that meaning.
The description identifies the affected resource consistently with armResourceIdentifier.
Target Azure resource ID clearly describes the refined identifier property.
Resource state error remains an accurate summary of the resource ID, error code, message and remediation fields.
Single role-assignment result accurately summarizes the target, identity, role, status and optional error fields after ID refinement.
Workspace evaluation properties still accurately summarizes the status, times and results model after its workspace ID type changes.
